remarks_original:
Where the days get easier and the living gets bigger.
You know the feeling you're after. The one where the house stops asking things of you, and the day opens up instead — whether that day still holds a full calendar of work or not.
It starts slow here, even on a workday. Coffee in your own private yard, fully enclosed and quiet, a clear head before the first call. When the laptop finally closes, the day is yours to stack however you like — a spirited game of pickleball, then a few laps in the pool, easing into the warm water of the spa as the afternoon winds down. Other days it's a walk to the lake, the water running over the rocks and the path looping you home. And the clubhouse has a way of gathering everyone, so good company is always close by.
The home is the part you stop thinking about. One level, all of it — no stairs at the end of a long day, now or twenty years from now — nothing half-finished, nothing waiting on you. It's attached, but it lives like a house of its own: your own entry, your own garage that brings you right inside, your own walls. The main living space opens up bright and easy, the kind of room that hosts a dinner as simply as it holds a quiet Tuesday. And the second room earns its keep — a real office on the working days, a soft landing for guests on the others, or the studio for the thing you finally have time to do.
Past the front door, all of Rancho Mission Viejo is yours: resort pools and spas, tennis and bocce, fitness studios, a dog park, and trails climbing up into the hills. And as a 55+ resident in Gavilan, you have something more — the exclusive amenities reserved just for this community, with an all-new recreation destination opening soon that takes the whole experience to another level. An ordinary week starts to feel like being away, even when you haven't gone anywhere.
This is the version of these years you've been picturing — upkeep shrinking, life expanding, on your schedule and around your work. Lock the door, head out, and let the community carry the rest.
Move-in ready and low-maintenance, this lock-and-leave home offers work-from-home flex space and lives like a single-family residence in the 55+ Gavilan enclave of Rancho Mission Viejo, South Orange County.

remarks_original:
This 3-bedroom, 2-bath home offers character and a peaceful place to unwind, with strong bones and room to make it your own. The open kitchen flows easily into the family room, creating a relaxed, connected space for everyday living. An outdoor laundry room keeps interior living space open and uncluttered.

Step outside to a flat, private backyard made for slowing down — shaded by fruit trees, including productive lemon trees, with plenty of room to garden, unwind, or simply enjoy the quiet. Two storage sheds and a second detached structure keep the space tidy and functional, while a covered carport comfortably fits two vehicles.

Big-ticket peace of mind comes standard: a roof that's only 3 years young, sewer line work already completed, and solar that will be paid off at closing — so you can settle in without worrying about what's next.

A great fit for a first-time buyer, or anyone looking for a home with character, calm, and room to grow.

remarks_original: Discover the grandeur of the historic Mendenhall Estate, a fully restored and expanded home with Gold Rush-era roots located at the base of Palomar Mountain. Originally settled in 1879 as part of the Rancho Cuca Mexican land, this custom home features interior design elements that reflect the decor of the early 1900s. Once home to the Mendenhall cattle ranching family, the estate beautifully blends California history with modern luxury.  Spanning 5,469 square feet and nestled on 1.81 acres, the property includes 5 bedrooms/5 bathrooms.  The home has been completely remodeled and restored to its former glory, featuring top-of-the-line finishes throughout, including dazzling K9 crystal accents on chandeliers, doorknobs, and even hot/cold shower handles. Bathrooms feature Bluetooth-enabled sound systems and ambient overhead lighting with customizable color settings, bringing spa-like comfort into everyday living. In the upstairs primary suite, custom wall sconces add a warm, designer touch to both the bedroom and bath, elevating the ambiance and craftsmanship throughout. The poured concrete walls provide insulation and tranquility, while tons of windows offer an abundance of natural light and stunning mountain views. The main level features Brazilian travertine floors, 3 bedrooms (with a primary en-suite), 2 bathrooms, an office, a sunroom, 2 fireplaces, and direct access to the thermal-pane heated pool and a yard inspired by English gardens. The chef's kitchen impresses with natural quartzite countertops and premium appliances, including Miele, Bosch, Fisher Paykel, and appliance garages. Additionally, there is a spacious secondary kitchen that offers ample counter space for food preparation with plenty of cabinets for storage.  The newly permitted top floor offers 1,752 square feet of living space, which includes two bedrooms, two bathrooms, and a loft area. It features beautiful cedar ceilings and luxurious Italian marble vanities, and the flooring is luxury vinyl planks that are waterproof. The remodeled upstairs has a primary suite that boasts a spacious bathroom with a jetted tub, set in a custom-designed alcove. Additionally, there are roomy his-and-her walk-in closets that allow for personalized storage solutions. Plus, in the closet, you'll also find washer-dryer hookups along with space for a folding table. The primary bedroom is generously sized and showcases an antique stained-glass window from a church dating back to the 1800s. This top floor has its own dedicated water heater, ensuring instant hot water through a recirculating line to the guest bathroom. Additionally, the primary bedroom is equipped with a beverage refrigerator and a marble-topped coffee bar. All toilets throughout the home are from the Toto brand. The 605 square foot finished walkout basement comprises a living space, a bathroom, laundry facilities, 4 windows, AC/heating, and a private entry. There are two staircases on each side of the house to access the upper quarters.  Other features include plantation shutters, coffered ceilings, and a French Empire Crystal Chandelier. The estate also features 55 paid-for and owned solar panels and a producing well that sources Palomar Mountain spring water. No more high utility bills!  All these provide an eco-efficient estate living. remarks_original: Charming Desert Hideaway with Pool, Spa & Mountain Views Welcome to this beautifully maintained custom-built home located in the highly desirable Harmony Acres neighborhood of Twentynine Palms. Offering over 1,800 square feet of comfortable living space, this 3-bedroom, 2-bath residence blends character, quality, and true desert charm. Built in 1992 and lovingly cared for, the home is in excellent condition and features unique architectural elements throughout. The main living area showcases a stunning cathedral-style vaulted ceiling that rises to a dramatic central peak, creating a spacious, open feel with striking visual appeal—a true centerpiece of the home. Designed to capture the essence of desert living, the home offers a seamless indoor-outdoor connection. Expansive windows from both the living room and kitchen frame the sparkling pool and spa, drawing your eye outside and creating the feeling that the outdoor space is part of the home itself—perfect for entertaining or simply enjoying peaceful desert days and evenings. Inside, you’ll also find a distinctive round bar, adding character and a great space to gather with friends and family, along with a functional and inviting layout designed for everyday living. Step outside to your private backyard retreat featuring a gunite pool and relaxing jacuzzi, surrounded by block walls for privacy and set against beautiful mountain views. Whether you're hosting guests or unwinding under the desert sky, this space offers the ideal setting. Additional highlights include a durable tile roof and a spacious 3-car garage, providing ample room for vehicles, storage, or hobbies. Conveniently located yet tucked away for privacy, this home is just one block from the well-known Huell Howser Estate, approximately 20 minutes to Joshua Tree National Park and the Village, 1 hour to Palm Springs, and about 2 hours to Big Bear Lake. Twentynine Palms continues to grow and attract attention, now home to the exciting Tortoise Rock Casino. Whether you’re searching for a full-time residence, vacation home, or investment opportunity, this one-of-a-kind property is a must-see. Schedule your private showing today and experience this exceptional desert retreat for yours

remarks_original: Welcome to Ironridge at Metro Heights, a new home community located in Montebello, CA which is approximately 20 minutes from downtown LA. Unit 503 is a new construction luxury condo located on the second floor. The Glenn floor plan features 3 bedrooms with 2 bathrooms a 2-car garage and is 1,447 sqft. Upon entering the home, you walk into the open floor plan,  which leads into kitchen. The kitchen features a kitchen island with a stainless-steel sink and Whirlpool appliances. The primary bedroom suite provides a beautiful walk-in closet and a spa like bath with a dual sink vanity. Highlights of this home are the 10ft. high ceilings throughout, and an upgraded interior insulation package, and a multi-slide stacked door leading to the  expansive balcony. The community amenities include multiple pocket parks, a walking trail, an attended front gate, and a 10,000 square foot community center with two pools, cabanas, multiple outdoor kitchens, office space, private areas for parties and a fitness center. Conveniently located near Montebello Shopping Center, the 60 and 605 freeways, and a variety of dining options. Unit 503 has an estimated closing date in November 2026. Photos provided are renderings, actual home is under construction.

remarks_original: Quiet front of building two-bedroom, 1-1/2 bath unit conveniently located in West LA.  Near UCLA, minutes from the beach with walking access to shopping, dining, and other entertainment as well as transit. Building has a security gate and gated covered parking. This corner unit includes two large bedrooms with generous walk-in closets. A sizable balcony off of the primary bedroom provides a place to relax and enjoy the view; balcony floor was redone last year. Big windows in every room, including both bathrooms, bring in abundant natural light throughout. Ceilings are approximately 12 feet, giving a spacious and open feel. The ample living area include a large storage closet, and a linen closet near the bedrooms. Additional locked storage is located in front parking area. Kitchen and bathrooms have hand-laid tile floors. Unit is part of a well-maintained, cozy 16-unit complex with most of the units customized. Just needs some refreshening to be an ideal first home.
